accounting.ROS_verified_arrival_records_scope: All ROS goals, including recovery; use split fields or NSO_exact_primitive_success_observations for primitive success.

limitations: No model, mapper, policy replay or ROS; no new coverage estimator.

Native arrived_count increments only when actual discrete pose equals current option.pose and collision is false (runtime_integration.py:353-356); it counts option endpoint arrivals, not ROS primitive arrivals. Native paid and ROS verified primitive arrival counts remain separate; startup without accepted observation has unknown native counts.
Discrete exact anchor equality and recorded return flag are not independent physical position truth.
Shadow rankings are within-state comparisons, not executed counterfactual trajectories; no effectiveness inference.
Q is the native fixed-old-support proxy; negative deltas preserved, not independent reconstruction accuracy.
Fresh-map differences, setup pose deviations and failures must remain visible in matched comparison.

Failed-action RPC observations charge attempts and fuse actual partial pose without arrival. Normal accepted paid observe is exact worker primitive success; native option arrivals and ROS verified records remain distinct.

recovery_accounting.cost_scope: Recovery and primitive brackets do not include all capture/planning/waits. Primary efficiency must use full episode CAN distance and elapsed time including recoveries.

coverage_efficiency.scope: Native observed area / full physical episode cost. Total area includes bootstrap/prior support; gain subtracts first accepted bootstrap ledger. Neither is independent ground truth.
coverage_efficiency.paid_attempt_curves_role: secondary; recoveries charge no additional NSO primitive but physical costs remain included

planned.scope: planned only; not evidence of traversal
